complaints.metaDescription: FreClean complaints and dispute resolution process for service issues, product concerns, billing questions, and formal review pathways.
complaints.title: Complaints & Dispute Resolution | FreClean
complaints.intro: FreClean welcomes feedback on service quality, product issues, billing questions, communication, and any concern that may require a formal review.
complaints.purposeDetails: We aim to resolve complaints fairly, promptly and in a way that is proportionate to the issue. This page sets out the public process for raising concerns about a product, service, payment, communication, or agreement.
complaints.earlyContact: Where possible, complaints should be raised directly with FreClean as soon as the issue is identified. Early communication helps us review the matter, gather relevant details, and identify a suitable remedy.
complaints.submissionDetails: Customers may raise a complaint by email at
complaints.submissionEvidence: . Please include the relevant date, service or product description, the issue experienced, any supporting photos or documents, and the expected resolution.
complaints.caseEvidence: When a complaint relates to a specific order, quote, service request, or payment, FreClean may ask for the confirmation message, invoice, receipt, or other evidence needed to review the matter fairly.
complaints.reviewDetails: FreClean reviews each complaint based on the information provided, the agreed scope of work or product details, and any record of communication between the parties. A complaint may lead to a clarification, correction, refund review, service remedy, apology, or other practical resolution.
complaints.escalation: Where a matter raises broader or more serious concerns, including product safety, misconduct, or repeated service failure, it may be escalated internally for a more formal review and a documented decision.
complaints.outcomeDetails: FreClean will communicate the outcome of the review as clearly as possible and explain whether the request is accepted, partially accepted, declined, or referred to a different process. If a dispute remains unresolved, a customer may request a reconsideration or may contact the relevant local authority or consumer protection channel, where applicable.
complaints.records: FreClean keeps records of complaints and resolution decisions to support accountability, consistency, and service improvement over time.
complaints.formalContact: For formal complaint or dispute concerns, email
complaints.framework: for the broader framework governing public information and customer communications.

refund.intro: FreClean reviews refund requests case by case. A refund is not automatic and depends on the exact service, product, payment route, and verified issue.
refund.eligibleDetails: Refunds may be considered for agreed service cancellations, product issues, confirmed disputes, or documented failures to meet the agreed outcome. The final outcome depends on proof, timing, and the terms established directly with FreClean at the time of the request.
refund.thirdParty: Where a third-party processor or crypto route is used, the final settlement and timing may be governed by that provider’s own terms. FreClean does not claim to control the processor’s settlement timeline for every payment method.
refund.requestDetails: Customers should contact FreClean with the transaction reference, the request or order details, the reason for the refund, and any supporting materials. FreClean may request further information before issuing a refund or alternative remedy.

shipping.customerDetails: Customers should review the product price, shipping method, shipping cost, tax, duties, customs obligations, and product restrictions before finalizing an order. FreClean does not promise a delivery date without direct confirmation.
shipping.availability: Shipping availability depends on destination, product eligibility, customs requirements, and operational capability. Some items may be restricted or unavailable in certain jurisdictions.
shipping.fulfillmentDetails: FreClean may confirm shipment method, tracking, dispatch timing, and final destination details directly with the customer. If a route is unavailable or restricted, FreClean will explain the limitation before completing a purchase or fulfillment action.
